project_info.theme: YSL makeup workshop registration with Libre EDP mini gift

main_subject.detail: A close portrait of a short-haired male beauty ambassador holding a miniature YSL Libre bottle up beside one eye inside a thin gold frame. The lower text says 'THAM GIA NGAY', 'MAKEUP WORKSHOP DUY NHẤT NGÀY 29.10', and on the right 'NHẬN NGAY LIBRE EDP 7.5ML' with 'Số lượng có hạn'. The whole poster uses a black marble background with gold crack veins.
